messages:
Ashley C: Heads-up: EU change window starts in 45m (22:00 UTC). Quick sync on gates + rollback owners. Who's got what?
Mike B: I'll drive traffic shifts. Will call holds at 5% and 25%.
Irene K: Taking release notes + smoke. Draft is here: https://redwood.internal/releases/3.14-draft 1 — includes DB migration steps flagged under 'Manual steps'.
Luke (oncall): I'll cover the oncall window for 60m post-cutover. Set alert thresholds: error-rate +0.5% absolute or p95 > 450ms. I'll escalate as needed.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: schedule accepted: release v3.14 -> prod at 22:15 UTC. Canary config: 5% for 10m. Command used: `/deploy start 3.14 --canary 5 --holdpoints 5,20`
Sophia R: Canary started on a small subset. Observing CPU and allocs. Initial mem increase ~8MB on one canary instance, not alarming.
Sam T: Frontend is pinned to v3.12 on prod. I will not unpin until Irene confirms post-deploy smoke. `cat frontend.lock` shows v3.12.
Ashley C: Quick checklist to mark as we go: 
- DB migration doc validated (Irene)
- Canary health green (Sophia)
- Release notes published (Irene)
- Traffic-shift plan owner (Mike)
- Rollback owner (Luke)
- Silence window set in calendar (Sam)
- Post-deploy smoke & metrics check (Irene + oncall)
Mike B: Traffic plan: 0 -> 5% (canary) -> 20% -> 100% over ~25-30m with manual holdpoints. I'll pause if any threshold trips.
Irene K: Smoke command to run after each shift: ```curl -fsS https://prod.internal/health || true``` Expect `{"ok":true}` and sample inference < 220ms.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary 5% initiated at 3290013100. Monitoring: #metrics and #eng-sre. Auto-pause enabled on SLO breaches.
Sophia R: Canary window first 5m: p95 170ms, error rate 0.02%. No alerts.
Luke (oncall): Rollback criteria posted: sustained 5xx >0.5% for 3m OR p95 > 500ms for 3m -> rollback to v3.13. If triggered I'll run `deploy rollback --version v3.13` and announce on #release-war-room.
Sam T: :thumbsup: Holding frontend unpin. Will only unpin after Irene posts final smoke pass.
Irene K: Canary smoke green at 22:24 UTC. All health endpoints pass, sample prompts look OK. Proceeding to 20%.
Mike B: Shifting to 20% now. Command: `/deploy shift 3.14 --to 20`
release-bot: release-bot: changelog published; customer-notify queue prepared. Internal note pinned to #product.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: traffic at 20% (3290013800). No new alerts in last 7m. Next step scheduled 20m from now.
Ashley C: If emergency rollback is needed, open #release-war-room and @channel. Luke will coordinate responders.
Sophia R: Observability: p95 185ms, error rate steady 0.03%. Memory anomaly resolved.
Irene K: Post-deploy smoke completed at 22:46 UTC. I give the green to proceed to 100%.
Mike B: Rolling to 100% now. `/deploy shift 3.14 --to 100`
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: shift to 100% in progress (3290015300). Rolling across regions; expected finish in ~10m.
release-bot: release-bot: final release notes posted; release summary sent to internal channels.
Luke (oncall): Monitoring continues for 30m post-rollout. If we see any drifting error budget, I'll start the rollback.
Ashley C: Thanks everyone 1 Launch looks good. I'll log follow-ups and retrospective items.
